name: flickdirect-connect
description: Search FlickDirect movie facts, entertainment reporting, interviews, podcasts and published provider links.

interface.longDescription:
Research movies, television and cinema-industry reporting with FlickDirect Connect, a read-only movie MCP server from FlickDirect Inc.

Search published movie and television facts, cast and crew, country-specific release dates and ratings when stored, production trivia and brief quote excerpts with source links. Search news, reviews, CinemaCon reporting, interviews and eligible stored transcripts. Discover podcast shows and episodes and recent uploads from FlickDirect's three published YouTube channels. Recent channel feeds and the podcast archive have bounded coverage.

Additional collections return soundtrack/provider destinations, app information, public company information and release anniversaries. Movie details include published streaming destinations. Provider availability and terms are controlled by the linked services. Connect does not operate checkout or process payments.

Results include canonical FlickDirect source links and retrieval evidence. Summaries and previews do not replace the full source. Missing values remain omitted; retrieval time does not guarantee that upstream information or offers are current. Connect does not supply full articles, reviews, transcripts or photographs. Published YouTube players depend on the host application's rendering support.

Existing search_fdmd and get_fdmd_movie calls remain supported as compatibility aliases for search_flickdirect_content and get_flickdirect_movie_details. Compatibility with an AI application does not imply its endorsement or an official partnership.
capabilities: Search movie and television facts and country-specific dates and ratings
Find news, reviews, interviews and CinemaCon reporting
Discover trivia, brief quote excerpts and source links
Find podcasts and recent YouTube uploads
Read published streaming and soundtrack destinations
Read public company and app information
defaultPrompt: Tell me some published movie production trivia, with links to the sources.
Find Terminator 2 and show the UK and Canadian dates and ratings FlickDirect has available.
Find FlickDirect articles about Samsung Onyx cinema technology.
